subject.title: feat(gateway): session dashboard domain — board RPCs, ticketed widgets, dashboard tool, per-agent persistence

question: Should the board widget endpoint require a ticket format that authenticates before any per-agent database lookup, with the route kept public only after that boundary is proven?
rationale: The PR introduces a new unauthenticated HTTP surface backed by synchronous persistent storage; the desired public-ticket boundary and acceptable admission behavior are security and availability decisions, although the concrete pre-lookup authentication repair is clear.

options.title: Require pre-lookup ticket authentication
options.body: Redesign the signed ticket so its binding can be verified before storage access, then prove invalid and expired requests do not open or query a board database.

options.title: Gate the route with equivalent admission
options.body: Keep the current lookup-dependent ticket format only if the route receives an equivalent authenticated admission and rate-limit boundary before SQLite work.

options.title: Pause the public widget route
options.body: Defer ticketed widget serving until the dashboard API has a reviewed public HTTP authorization design.

recommendation.title: Require pre-lookup ticket authentication
recommendation.body: Redesign the signed ticket so its binding can be verified before storage access, then prove invalid and expired requests do not open or query a board database.

likelyOwner.reason: Owns the current dashboard and ticket implementation history, including the prior ticket hardening commits.
